plugins.name: bug-detective
plugins.description: Systematically debug issues with step-by-step troubleshooting approaches.

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Adds a /retrospective command that captures session learnings and prepares a Skill PR to the team registry.

plugins.name: advise
plugins.description: Consult the team registry to surface warnings, proven configurations, and shortcuts relevant to the current task.

plugins.name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
plugins.description: Brutal, high-conviction architectural audit focusing on maintainability, the 1k-line rule, spaghetti logic, and code-judo. Protects against slop.

plugins.name: doc
plugins.description: Create and manage structured documentation — experiments, plans, findings, checkpoints, research, per-spec task trackers, and learnings. Config-driven, parallel-safe.

plugins.name: add-a-loop
plugins.description: Add a recurring reminder or background job ("loop") to the qdb loops subsystem from the CLI — the serve → add → list flow, schedule forms, kinds, and gateway delivery.

plugins.name: bro
plugins.description: Re-explain the previous assistant message in plain language — use /bro when the last reply was too dense or jargon-heavy.
